sections.title: David's Last Words
observations: This section presents the final words of David, which are poetic and reflect his deep relationship with God. David acknowledges his role as a servant of the Lord and emphasizes the importance of righteousness and justice in leadership.
The phrase 'the Spirit of the Lord spoke by me' indicates that David's words are divinely inspired, underscoring the significance of his legacy as a king who sought to follow God's will.

sections.title: David's Mighty Men
observations: This passage lists David's mighty warriors, highlighting their bravery and loyalty. These men were instrumental in David's reign and demonstrate the value of strong leadership and camaraderie in achieving great feats.
The mention of specific exploits, such as defeating giants and taking risks for David, illustrates the theme of sacrifice and dedication to a cause greater than oneself.

importantVerses.commentary: David's last words reflect his understanding of God's covenant and his role as a leader.
David's acknowledgment of the worth of his mighty men emphasizes the importance of loyalty and sacrifice.

questions: What do David's last words reveal about his understanding of leadership and his relationship with God?
How do the exploits of David's mighty men reflect the values of loyalty and bravery in the context of biblical leadership?
